description: An agent drafts a slide deck, and you keep it or ask for changes. Night Shift commits the deck you keep.

inputs.name: source
inputs.label: Source
inputs.description: What the deck is about: notes, the text of a ticket, a file in the project, or a git range such as `v1.2..HEAD`.

outputs.name: deck
outputs.description: The last draft of the deck.

nodes.label: Draft the deck
Keep or change?
nodes.prompt:
Keep this deck, or write in the note what to change.

Deck:

```markdown
{{draft.data.deck}}
```

options.name: keep
options.description: Save the deck in the project and commit it.

options.name: revise
options.description: An agent changes the deck to follow your note. You can ask 3 times.

nodes.label: Save and commit
nodes.command:
# Writes the deck you kept to the project and commits it.
set -e
mkdir -p "$(dirname "{{file}}")"
printf '%s\n' "{{draft.data.deck}}" > "{{file}}"
git add -- "{{file}}"
if git diff --cached --quiet; then
	echo 'Nothing changed.'
	exit 0
fi
git commit -q -m "draft-slides: {{file}}"

nodes.message: You asked for changes 3 times. Start a new run, and add your notes to the source.
